description: ol-style-nested-handler is gated on the interaction-events profile, and this pins that gate STACK-NEUTRALLY rather than only in a unit test. Core-only, every is not a visible block-head at all, so the program yields ol-unknown-command for each every and no style finding whatsoever - a rule must consult the active profile set rather than assume every optional profile is on. Follows the convention of set-tempo-without-sound-profile, explain-without-educational-profile, and the other *-without-*-profile siblings; by that convention this one lives under core-language/ rather than beside the interaction-events/style fixtures it complements
